statement: A top-3 compute jurisdiction legislates guaranteed public access to frontier AI, or an AI dividend or sovereign fund paid to citizens (official gazette, by 2028-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met in 2024 and no bill pending. Bloc A launched a pilot shared compute/model resource for researchers and educators (not the general public, not statutory). Bloc B's government work report introduced an 'AI+' action focused on industrial adoption, with no access right or dividend. The main dividend-related evidence was a large privately funded unconditional-cash RCT (backed by a frontier-lab CEO) reporting results; a research input, not policy.

items.summary: Bloc A's science agency, with 10 other agencies and 25 private/non-profit partners, launched a pilot national AI research resource giving researchers and educators access to compute, datasets and models. Research access only, not a statutory public-access guarantee.
items.detail: Bloc A NSF, 'Democratizing the future of AI R&D: NSF to launch National AI Research Resource pilot', 2024-01-24 (verified via search snippet). Pilot under EO 14110; the authorising CREATE AI Act was not passed in 2024.

items.summary: Bloc B's annual government work report first announced an 'AI+' action to deepen AI R&D and application and build a national integrated compute system. Industrial policy; no public-access right or citizen dividend.
items.detail: Bloc B, 2024 Government Work Report (Premier Li Qiang, NPC 2024-03-05): '开展“人工智能+”行动' (gov.cn / Xinhua, verified via search snippet).

items.summary: A privately funded randomised trial (3,000 low-income adults; $1,000/month for 3 years vs $50 control), backed by a frontier-lab chief executive, reported results: spending up ~$310/month, total non-transfer income down ~$1,900/year, labour participation down ~4 pp. Evidence input for AI-dividend debates, not policy.
items.detail: OpenResearch Unconditional Income Study (Illinois and Texas, funded in part by Sam Altman); NBER Working Papers w32719 (Vivalt et al.) and w32784, July 2024. Release day approximate (results widely reported 2024-07-22).

items.summary: No bill to guarantee public access to frontier AI or create an AI dividend / sovereign fund paid to citizens was found in any top-3 compute jurisdiction during 2024.
items.detail: Light search of Bloc A Congress, Bloc B NPC and Bloc C legislative records; none found. Not exhaustive.
